posts.materialUpdate: Aldar announced Sei Saadiyat on 7 September 2026 and confirmed first-phase sales open on 16 September 2026.
posts.body:
SEI SAADIYAT — FIRST SALES RELEASE

Aldar has announced Sei Saadiyat in Saadiyat Cultural District. Phase one brings 265 homes across two buildings, with 1–3 bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom lofts. Sales are scheduled to open on 16 September 2026.

Broker listings indicate prices from AED 2.95 million, a 50/50 plan and Q4 2030 handover; these commercial terms have not yet been confirmed in an accessible Aldar price list.

posts.materialUpdate: Bloom Holding's Alhambra final residential release was announced in dated launch coverage on 9 September 2026.
posts.body:
ALHAMBRA — BLOOM LIVING’S FINAL RELEASE

Bloom Holding has launched Alhambra in Zayed City as the final residential release at Bloom Living. The mix includes studios to 3-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom townhouses and a limited number of 4-bedroom penthouses.

Developer-indexed launch information states prices from AED 865,000. A 40/60 plan and Q3 2030 handover are circulating in broker material and remain subject to final confirmation.
